headline: ABOUT ZEITGEIST
description: Zeitgeist is the annual national-level technical festival of the Department of Information Technology, Kannur University, Mangattuparamba Campus. A convergence of intellect, creativity, and technology — Zeitgeist brings together the brightest minds to compete, collaborate, and push the boundaries of innovation.
sub_description: From coding marathons and design challenges to gaming arenas and intellectual debates, Zeitgeist 2K26 is a two-day celebration of the spirit of the age — where technology meets human potential.
